title: Accommodations by Achievement Deficit — Catalog
description: Index of accommodation/strategy files organized by academic skill area (reading, math, spelling, writing, penmanship). Use when the student's IEP present-levels indicate below-grade-level performance in a specific subject skill. Source: Seaman Compendium Sections Two and Three.

files.title: Basic Math Skill Deficits
files.description: Use when the student has below-grade-level basic math skills (counting, number recognition, math facts, computation algorithms). Strategies subdivided via applies_when tags.

files.title: Basic Reading Skill Deficits
files.description: Use when the student has below-grade-level basic reading skills (decoding, word recognition, fluency, sight vocabulary). Strategies subdivided across motivation, letter-names-sounds, phonetic-decoding, sight-vocabulary, reading-fluency.

files.title: Math Reasoning and Problem Solving Deficits
files.description: Use when the student has weak math reasoning (math concepts, story problems). Strategies subdivided via applies_when tags.

files.title: Penmanship and Copying Fluency Deficits
files.description: Use when the student has below-grade-level handwriting or copying speed/accuracy. Note: source has no Instructional Strategies subsection.

files.title: Reading Comprehension Deficits
files.description: Use when the student has below-grade-level reading comprehension despite adequate decoding. Often co-occurs with comprehension-knowledge cognitive deficit.

files.title: Research-Supported Academic Accommodation Techniques
files.description: Named, evidence-based instructional techniques (SQ4R, Drill Sandwich, Cover-Copy-Compare, Listening Previewing, Story Mapping, etc.) with step-by-step procedures. Use when the teacher needs a specific named technique with implementation steps.

files.title: Spelling Deficits
files.description: Use when the student has below-grade-level spelling. Often co-occurs with phonemic-awareness deficits and dyslexia.
